title: 第15章 融入第16章 炼气三层
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
当一位眉宇间带着高傲之色的八九岁少年从人群中走出时，朔衡一眼就认出了他是谁。
气运之子，与林未醒相同。
没想到，他会被排在第一个。
【小四，查看陈尘的面板。】
【姓名：陈尘
性别：男
年龄：9
气运：金色
修为：炼气七层
灵根：冰系圣灵根
根骨：极寒之瞳（尚未觉醒）
臣服值：0】
朔衡看着陈尘的面板，若有所思。
“大哥，我记得，大陆上是不是有一个很出名的陈家？”
朔千夜点点头：“是的。东域陈家，在整个梵阳界也是首屈一指的大势力，三宫六家九殿的六家之一。
陈尘乃是当今陈家嫡系次子。”
朔衡哦了一声，那就怪不得这小子没有给他贡献积分呢。
一看就是位眼高于顶的大少爷，正是觉得自己“天下无敌”的中二年纪。
这样的人薅起来，似乎会格外有趣。
陈尘最终的测试结果也没有让人失望。

冰系圣灵根，虽然没有其他的天赋根骨（未觉醒无法被检测），但已然十分不错了。
其实陈尘在三年前开始修炼时就已经测过一次，但考核时检测灵根乃是苍澜仙宫的规矩，也是为了避免一些人谎报天赋而设计的必要流程。
登记长老一脸高兴：“陈尘，冰系圣灵根，通过测试！”
“这两个孩子还真是给我们收徒大典开了个好头。”苍凛笑了笑，看向陈尘的目光中带着些满意，却并无太过明显的欣赏。
天赋很高。
只是这心性，还需历练。
“这个孩子不错，若是诸位不感兴趣的话，那我望月峰就预定了哦。”
春池圣君，望月峰峰主，掌管苍澜仙宫任务阁所在，权力地位可以说仅次于苍凛和洺万里之下。
“那就要问卓晔圣君是不是也有同样的想法了。”
沈越摆摆手，示意他不参与争夺此子。
其余峰主也没有太过激动，毕竟朔衡珠玉在前，直接把他们的眼界拔高不少。
若是放在以往，可能还会因为陈尘的出现而争抢一番。
接下来的测试，可以说是无趣中透露着些许惊喜。
圣灵根举世罕见，天灵根较为稀少，而凡是达不到地灵根程度的少年们，则会永远失去进入第二关考核的资格。
这也意味着，他们失去了进入仙宫的资格。
修仙界的残酷初显，运气与实力，缺一不可。
期间，朔衡着重留意了一下林未醒和陆纵横。
【姓名：林未醒
性别：男
content_en:
When an eight or nine-year-old boy with a proud look on his eyebrows walked out of the crowd, Shuo Heng recognized who he was at a glance.
The son of luck is the same as Lin Weixing.
Unexpectedly, he would be ranked first.
[Xiaosi, check Chen Chen’s panel. 】
[Name: Chen Chen
Gender: Male
Age: 9
Luck: golden
Cultivation: Seventh level of Qi refining
Spiritual Root: Ice Holy Spirit Root
Root Bone: Eye of Extreme Cold (not yet awakened)
Surrender value: 0]
Shuo Heng looked at Chen Chen's panel, thoughtfully.
"Brother, I remember, is there a very famous Chen family on the mainland?"
Shuo Qianye nodded: "Yes. The Chen family in the Eastern Region is also the leading power in the entire Fanyang world, one of the six families in the Three Palaces, Six Families and Nine Palaces.
Chen Chen is the second son of the current Chen family. "
Shuo Heng said oh, no wonder this guy didn't contribute points to him.
At first glance, you can see that he is a young master with high eyesight. He is the middle-aged man who feels that he is "invincible".
It seems particularly interesting to gather such people together.
Chen Chen’s final test results did not disappoint.
Although the Ice Holy Spirit Root does not have other talent roots (it cannot be detected before awakening), it is already very good.
In fact, Chen Chen had already taken the test once when he started practicing three years ago. However, testing spiritual roots during the assessment is a rule of Canglan Immortal Palace, and it is also a necessary process designed to prevent some people from lying about their talents.
The registration elder looked happy: "Chen Chen, ice-type Holy Spirit root, passed the test!"
"These two children really gave us a good start for our apprenticeship ceremony." Cang Lin smiled and looked at Chen Chen with some satisfaction, but no obvious appreciation.
Very talented.
It’s just that this character still needs to be tempered.
"This kid is good. If you are not interested, then I will make a reservation at Wangyue Peak."
The Holy Lord of Chunchi, the master of Wangyue Peak, is in charge of the mission pavilion of Canglan Immortal Palace, and his power status can be said to be second only to Cang Lin and Ming Wanlixia.
"Then I have to ask Holy Lord Zhuo Ye if he has the same idea."
Shen Yue waved his hand, indicating that he would not participate in the fight for the son.
The other peak masters were not too excited. After all, Shuo Heng Zhuyu was in front, which directly raised their horizons a lot.
If it had been in the past, there might have been a fight over it because of Chen Chen's appearance.
The next test can be said to be boring with some surprises.
Holy Spirit Roots are rare in the world, and Heavenly Spiritual Roots are even rarer. Youngsters who cannot reach the level of Earthly Spiritual Roots will forever lose their qualifications to enter the second level of assessment.
This also means that they lose the qualification to enter the Immortal Palace.
The cruelty of the world of immortality is beginning to show, and luck and strength are indispensable.
During this period, Shuo Heng paid special attention to Lin Weixing and Lu Zongheng.

Gender: Male
